📰 General

Swiss Police Identify All 116 Injured in Crans-Montana New Year’s Bar Fire •

Swiss police have confirmed that all 116 individuals injured in a devastating fire at a New Year’s celebration in Crans-Montana, Switzerland, have been identified. The fire occurred at a crowded bar, resulting in a large number of casualties. Currently, over two-thirds of the injured remain hospitalized as they receive medical care. Authorities are continuing to investigate the cause of the blaze, which caused significant damage to the venue.

🌍 World

Berlin Faces Continued Blackouts as Arson Attack Disrupts Power Grid •

An ongoing power outage in Berlin is attributed to a suspected arson attack carried out by left-wing extremists. Authorities believe the attack targeted a power substation, causing widespread disruption to electricity supply across the city. Emergency services are working to restore power, but significant portions of Berlin remain without electricity. The incident has prompted investigations into the perpetrators and the circumstances surrounding the attack.

🦅 US

Trump Reaffirms Desire to Annex Greenland, Sparking Danish Outrage •

Former President Donald Trump stated on Sunday that he intends to seize control of Greenland, a territory within the Kingdom of Denmark. Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen responded by demanding that Mr. Trump cease his threats regarding the annexation of the semiautonomous region. Denmark maintains sovereignty over Greenland, which has a degree of self-governance. The Danish government views Mr. Trump’s comments as a serious and destabilizing provocation.

💰 Business

Michael Burry Bets on U.S. Intervention in Venezuela’s Oil Sector •

Investor Michael Burry has maintained a long-held position in Valero Energy since 2020, anticipating a significant shift in the U.S.’s involvement with Venezuela. Burry believes the U.S. government’s growing interest in taking control of Venezuelan oil reserves will dramatically increase the value of Valero Energy. The investment strategy centers on the potential for a U.S. takeover of Venezuelan oil production, a scenario he has been preparing for years. Analysts suggest this bet reflects a belief in a more active U.S. role in the South American nation’s energy sector.

💻 Technology

Albishorn Unveils Beige “Type 10 Officer” Chronograph With Bronze Crown •

Albishorn has released a new variation of its manually-wound Type 10 chronograph, debuting in late 2025. The timepiece features a beige dial accented with black Super-LumiNova and incorporates a bronze crown. This new iteration continues the brand’s established “imaginary vintage” design language. The chronograph utilizes a manually-wound movement and maintains the brand’s focus on vintage-inspired aesthetics.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya graced the 2024 Met Gala with a breathtaking custom Valentino Haute Couture gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. Attendees and photographers captured numerous images of the actress as she navigated the event, highlighting the gown’s intricate detailing. The Met Gala’s theme was “Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion,” and Zendaya’s appearance was widely considered a standout moment.

🏅 Sports

2026 NFL Playoff Bracket Released: Schedule and Teams Confirmed for Upcoming Season •

The 2026 NFL playoff bracket has been officially released, outlining the matchups for the upcoming postseason. The Pittsburgh Steelers secured their AFC division title with a decisive 26-24 victory over the Baltimore Ravens in the final regular season game. The bracket details all 16 playoff teams and their scheduled games, marking the culmination of the 18-week regular season. Fans can now view the complete schedule and anticipate the start of the competitive playoff rounds.

🔬 Science

Engineer Develops Novel Device Claiming to Defy Earth’s Gravitational Pull •

An engineer has designed a machine that, if functional, could generate thrust without relying on traditional propellant expulsion. The device utilizes a complex system of oscillating magnetic fields to create a force, theoretically allowing for movement in a vacuum. Researchers are currently investigating the underlying physics and potential applications of this innovative approach. Initial tests have demonstrated a measurable force, though significant challenges remain in scaling the technology for practical use. Further research is focused on understanding and controlling the generated force.

🩺 Health

Oklahoma Health Department Defies Pressure, Maintains Statewide-Only Measles Data •

The Oklahoma State Department of Health is withholding county-level data regarding measles outbreaks, despite growing concerns from public health officials. The department currently only releases statewide measles case numbers, citing privacy concerns. This approach contrasts with practices in other states, where more granular data is routinely shared to track and manage outbreaks effectively. Critics argue this limited data hinders the ability to identify hotspots and implement targeted interventions. The department’s decision has raised questions about transparency and public health monitoring within the state.
